response.sql:
SELECT p.ID,
       AVG(l.UA) AS average_uric_acid,
       AVG(l.HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS ra_record
  ON ra_record.ID = p.ID
 AND ra_record.RA IS NOT NULL
 AND ra_record.RA <> '-'
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         AVG(l.HCT) DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A recorded RA result means a non-NULL value; values are compared exactly with '-' (so an empty string qualifies).
